# shc_machine_types (Data Source)

Fetches the SHC ordering catalog, listing available VPS machine types with specs and pricing.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `machine_types` (Attributes List) The list of available VPS machine types with resource specs and pricing. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--machine_types))

<a id="nestedatt--machine_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `machine_types`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (Number) The number of CPU cores.
- `disk_gb` (Number) The amount of disk space in gigabytes.
- `memory_mb` (Number) The amount of memory in megabytes.
- `name` (String) The human-readable name of the machine type.
- `package_id` (Number) The SHC package ID.
- `price_daily` (String) The daily price for this machine type, if available.
- `price_monthly` (String) The monthly price for this machine type, if available.
- `price_weekly` (String) The weekly price for this machine type, if available.
